en: This is a vintage postcard with two sides shown: the back features handwritten Swedish text, two green 5 öre stamps from Sweden depicting a lion, and an address in Stockholm. The front displays an old photograph of a grand, classical-style building labeled 'SUNDSVALLS ENSKILDA BANK' with a large decorative fountain in the foreground. The caption below the image reads 'Sundsvall Enskilda Banken'.
